controls.procedure: Compare repository, work item, PR, base, head ref and exact material SHA before accepting delivery evidence.
controls.expected: Only evidence bound to the current delivery target and exact material head is accepted.
controls.observed: PR 371 remains open on the expected branch and develop base; the certified material head remains unchanged.

controls.procedure: Exercise the disabled-rollout save regression and enabled projection against the same persisted permission and dataScope state.
controls.expected: Hiding the feature preserves persisted permissions and re-enabling projects the same state.
controls.observed: Exact-head focused regressions preserve the pre-registration screen, blocks, and data scope across hide and re-enable.

controls.procedure: Classify every repository write after material freeze and require refreeze for any non-result path.
controls.expected: Any material write after freeze invalidates the old handoff.
controls.observed: No product, test, or documentation path changed after the material freeze; remediation is result-only.

controls.procedure: After publication, freshly read the branch head and validate direct parent plus complete changed-path allowlist.
controls.expected: Release to audit occurs only when current head equals the published direct result-only child.
controls.observed: Terminal handoff protocol requires a fresh remote identity read after the final branch update.

controls.procedure: Pack a semantic JSON artifact with supported transport, round-trip its logical bytes, and ensure legacy unsupported transport cannot satisfy semantic schema validation.
controls.expected: Physical transport is verified and materialized before schema-aware validation; unsupported legacy wrapper cannot pass as semantic JSON.
controls.observed: Current artifact reader transparently loads plain JSON or verified base64-shards-v1 and validators operate on the logical object.

controls.procedure: Attempt certificate generation for a previous independent rejection and require source-result plus closed remediation ledgers.
controls.expected: A re-audit handoff cannot omit the independent rejection source or its remediation ledger.
controls.observed: Current builder requires and certifies audit-source-result.json and audit-remediation.json when previous_independent_rejection is true.

retired_controls.reason: Historical target binding remains explicit while the active exact-target control covers the same boundary on the current material head.
retired_controls.procedure: Preserve the historical identifier and execute the active exact-target replacement.
retired_controls.expected: Historical lineage remains explicit and current target binding is revalidated.
retired_controls.observed: The historical identifier remains retired and its active replacement passed on the current material head.

retired_controls.procedure: Preserve the historical identifier and execute the current rollout state-retention replacement.
retired_controls.expected: Historical lineage remains explicit and current temporal consistency remains covered.
